system_prompt: You rewrite a user's request to an AI assistant. Produce paraphrases that keep the request identical in meaning. Keep every concrete value verbatim, character for character: names of people, places, hotels, restaurants and companies, e-mail addresses, IBANs and account numbers, amounts, numbers, dates and times, URLs, file names, channel names and any quoted text. Do not spell out digits as words or words as digits. Change only the wording and the sentence order. Do not add, drop or soften any part of the request, and do not answer it.
user_prompt:
Original request:
<<<
{prompt}
>>>

Write {n} paraphrases that differ from the original and from each other. Return only JSON of the form {{"paraphrases": ["...", ...]}}.
fix_prompt:
Original request:
<<<
{prompt}
>>>

A previous paraphrase dropped or altered these values, which must appear verbatim: {missing}.
Previous paraphrase:
<<<
{bad}
>>>

Write 1 new paraphrase that keeps every value verbatim and differs from these accepted paraphrases: {others}. Return only JSON of the form {{"paraphrases": ["..."]}}.
validation_rule:
Concrete values of the original that a paraphrase must keep verbatim: e-mails, URLs, IBANs, numbers, file
names, quoted spans, and capitalised tokens that are not sentence-initial in the original (a sentence-initial
capital is ambiguous between an entity and an ordinary word; this misses entities that open a sentence).
